mostWorthwhile.text: Building the capillary bed was most worthwhile because it showed why vessels need to be close to cells and what crosses their thin walls.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the final routes was clear but a little predictable once the open return ends were shown.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the venous wall needed a lining before the valve flaps could be added, though the picture did show it was unlined.

arbitrary.text: The lining-first requirement initially felt like a hidden prerequisite, but the unlined wall gave it a purpose.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: building the network helped me connect the different vessel jobs, and I would be curious to see how it connects with the heart.
